prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Go back and look at the specific building, apartment building or multi-family building as it exists now.
3. Look at what you (or your inspector) found when you looked at it.
4. Look at the compliance checklist and figure out why it failed and why it doesn’t meet the requirement of the specific code.
5. Identify what steps or solutions that the owner or building can do to resolve the issue.
6. Determine what further documentation you need from the owner to continue, like photographs, documents, plans developed by experts, etc. (No documents are needed for all requirements, like #4 below).
7. Identify the sections of the NYC Fire Code including the Mechanical, Fuel Gas and Electrical Code that includes the requirement that the owner is not complying with (This part is critical).
8. Take the required corrective actions (ownership responsibility).

---
